adversarialDesign.missingRowSql: SELECT m.county_fips, m.county_name FROM county_manifest m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM county_facet_coverage c WHERE c.county_fips = m.county_fips AND c.facet = 'flood') ORDER BY m.county_fips. Plus COUNT(*) of that set. Database neondb. Project fancy-fire-06136146. Bounded to 254-row manifest minus flood coverage rows. Not an atoms query.
adversarialDesign.existsProbe: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atoms WHERE entity_type = 'flood-hazard-fact' AND entity_id >= '{fips}:' AND entity_id < '{fips};'). Database hauska_mcp if present on the same project. Unique index atoms_entity_composite_unique (entity_type, entity_id) per _inbox/2026-08-21_r07_store_grade.md Q1a. Semicolon is next ASCII after colon, so the range is the FIPS prefix without left().
adversarialDesign.announce: Before first EXISTS: not a heavy scan, 76 index probes plus two instrument-fire controls.
adversarialDesign.goRule: GO = EXISTS true AND FIPS is in the missing-77 minus Donley. Later score without new apply via tsx artifacts/api-server/src/countyFloodScoreCli.ts --county={fips} (write path omits --dry-run; that writes county_facet_coverage, not atoms). NO-GO-no-atoms = EXISTS false. skip-Donley = 48129.
adversarialDesign.secondMechanismForMissing77: A1 named L24 remainder 77/77 NDJSON READY with no atoms --apply as an alternate that would produce the same 77 missing rows. This lane's EXISTS split tests that: if most of 76 have no atoms, L24-never-applied is the surviving mechanism; if most have atoms, scorer-never-invoked-per-county is the surviving mechanism.
